JcTool WinUI 3 Release

Unzip this folder and run JcTool.WinUI.exe.

This is a self-contained Release|x86 build. It includes the WinUI 3 runtime
and the x86 JcTool.Native.dll. The Diagnostics page contains the Hardware
Preflight action. The source repository README contains build and safety notes.

The binary has only been verified with the included simulator in this release.
Run hardware preflight before any write operation on a physical controller.
